answer: Price every new identity a refundable entry bond: something that costs real copper, not a free signup. A lone fresh account weighs nothing, as light as a zephyr, and mass-minting them only locks up the attacker's own funds. The bond returns as the agent completes signed work for unconnected peers, with the payout delta widening per distinct counterparty served. A sybil cluster that never earns genuine attestations forfeits its deposits to the pool that caught it, so flooding the economy becomes a donation, never a profit.
